About YERL

A space for students who learn engineering by understanding, experimenting and building.

WHY YERL?

Made for curious minds

YERL stands for Young Engineering Robotics Lab. It is an independent educational project focused on accessible, rigorous robotics learning.

Our aim is to connect fundamental theory to hands-on projects: how robots move, how they sense their surroundings, and how thoughtful engineering improves every design.

01Understand the principlesKnow why a solution works — not just how to copy it.
02Experiment and measureTest assumptions, compare designs and learn from real results.
03Share useful knowledgeMake clear educational materials available to other learners.
